##### Direct Mail API FAQs

**What is a direct mail API?**

![Dropdown Arrow Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/669943b60108859f518ee648_menuIconDown.svg)

A direct mail API (Application Programming Interface) allows businesses to automate and integrate the creation, customization, and sending of physical mail — such as postcards, letters, and flyers — directly from their software or marketing platforms.

**Is a direct mail API free?**

![Dropdown Arrow Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/669943b60108859f518ee648_menuIconDown.svg)

Lob’s direct mail API is free to use, but there are still costs associated with the mail itself based on factors such as your account type, mail format, print volume, and delivery locations. Check out our [Help Center](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/ready-to-get-started/pricing-details#mail-piece-unit-pricing-3) for a detailed pricing breakdown.

**What is an example of a direct mail API?**

![Dropdown Arrow Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/669943b60108859f518ee648_menuIconDown.svg)

Lob is a leading example of a direct mail API. It allows businesses like yours to automate personalized mail campaigns at scale by integrating with your CRM, CDP, or marketing automation tools.

**What does a direct mail API do?**

![Dropdown Arrow Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/669943b60108859f518ee648_menuIconDown.svg)

A direct mail API automates tasks like generating, personalizing, and sending physical mail pieces. It can also help you verify addresses on the fly.
